notes: Sound now actually plays in Review & swap — press Play (or Space) and you HEAR the cut, not just see it (the earlier build looked like it was playing but stayed silent; that's fixed). It plays through the panel, so watch for sound in your headphones/speakers rather than Premiere's meters. It plays the real mic under the playhead, so a cross-camera audio override is audible too. Audio override: in Settings → Cutting, each camera has an "Audio from" mic (default its own) — if a camera's mic is dead, point it at another camera and the whole cut uses that mic when that camera is shown; or override a single shot from the Audio dropdown in Review & swap. "R" reveals every other camera angle on the current shot (switched off) so you can hand-pick any angle while the cut stays put. The Voices list folds away to save space. Fixed earlier: shuffling cameras quickly (1-2-3) no longer crashes Premiere — every timeline edit is serialised and paced so Premiere never gets two or back-to-back edits at once.
